Life at Kueez

We move fast, think big, and continuously push boundaries to stay ahead in a competitive digital landscape - all while keeping things fun, collaborative, and down to earth.

How It All Started

Kueez launched in 2016 with a clear ambition: to create a content platform offering light, wholesome entertainment. Identifying the limitations of existing online publishing tools in a rapidly evolving digital landscape, we developed an innovative, performance-driven solution. Our cutting-edge technology streamlined and enhanced every aspect of the publishing process.

By 2018, our proprietary technology powered over 120 websites, reaching more than 200 million monthly readers. This rapid growth earned us recognition from SimilarWeb as one of the top 10 fastest-growing publishers in the United States.

Where We Are Today

Today, Kueez is a leading force in global digital publishing and performance marketing technology. Our commitment to excellence has placed us among Israel’s 10 fastest-growing companies, as recognized by Globes and Statista.

At the heart of our success is a deep commitment to our people - their well-being, growth, and development - fostering a culture where talent is nurtured, voices are heard, and careers thrive.

Our Values

Can-do attitude

We take a resourceful, creative, bold approach to what we do. Every one of our team members is a big-thinker, who perpetually strives to do it all, is up for complex missions, and shares that “challenge accepted” energy.

Data-driven everything

Every step we make is based on meticulously collected data. Whether it’s business goals, creative aspects, media buying strategy, or task prioritization – we run countless tests to give us the smartest outputs.

Trust

Transparency is a big deal for us, and it’s been that way since the very beginning. Our mission is to establish relationships based on trust with publishers, clients, and users - we do so by complying with all privacy regulations, always.
